rows.title: Aircraft seats
rows.officialDescription: Seats of a kind used for aircraft
rows.material: Any material; aircraft use determines this branch
rows.condition: A seat of a kind used for aircraft; distinguish complete seats from separate parts.
rows.note: An aircraft-styled lounge chair is not classified here merely because of its appearance.

rows.title: Motor-vehicle seats
rows.officialDescription: Seats of a kind used for motor vehicles
rows.material: Any material; motor-vehicle use determines this branch
rows.condition: A seat of a kind used for motor vehicles; confirm the actual construction and use.
rows.note: Do not assume a child safety seat uses this branch. National definitions and rulings must be checked.

rows.title: Wooden swivel seats with height adjustment
rows.officialDescription: Swivel seats with variable height adjustment: Of wood
products: Wooden swivel chairs with variable height adjustment
rows.condition: Both swivel and variable height adjustment are required; assess whether the seat is of wood.
rows.note: A swivel-only or height-adjustable-only chair does not automatically meet this branch. Upholstery does not remove the need to check this special seat category first.

rows.title: Other swivel seats with height adjustment
rows.officialDescription: Swivel seats with variable height adjustment: Other
products: Non-wooden swivel office chairs with variable height adjustment
rows.condition: Both swivel and variable height adjustment are required; exclude the wooden branch.
rows.note: A loose gas-lift cylinder is not a complete seat. Classify a replacement mechanism on its own facts.

rows.title: Wooden seats convertible into beds
rows.officialDescription: Seats other than garden seats or camping equipment, convertible into beds: Of wood
products: Wooden sofa beds meeting this branch
rows.condition: A seat convertible into a bed, of wood; this branch excludes garden seats and camping equipment.
rows.note: The word futon may describe a convertible seat or a separate mattress. Determine which article is imported.

rows.title: Other seats convertible into beds
rows.officialDescription: Seats other than garden seats or camping equipment, convertible into beds: Other
products: Metal sofa beds meeting this branch
rows.condition: A seat convertible into a bed, other than of wood; this branch excludes garden seats and camping equipment.
rows.note: A folding camping bed is not classified here merely because it folds or can be sat on.

rows.title: Bamboo seats
rows.officialDescription: Seats of cane, osier, bamboo or similar materials: Of bamboo
products: Bamboo chairs or benches meeting this branch
rows.condition: The article must be a bamboo seat within this material branch.
rows.note: Check the actual structural materials; a bamboo finish or bamboo-look pattern does not establish classification.

rows.title: Rattan seats
rows.officialDescription: Seats of cane, osier, bamboo or similar materials: Of rattan
products: Natural-rattan chairs or settees meeting this branch
rows.condition: The seat must be of rattan within this material branch; identify the frame and other components.
rows.note: Wicker describes a construction method. PE rattan and resin wicker are not natural rattan; do not use this code from the sales name alone.

rows.title: Seats of other cane-like materials
rows.officialDescription: Seats of cane, osier, bamboo or similar materials: Other
products: Seats of osier or other qualifying similar materials, other than bamboo or rattan
rows.material: Cane, osier or similar materials other than bamboo or rattan
rows.condition: Identify the actual material and confirm this branch applies before selecting its residual subheading.
rows.note: A woven surface on a wooden or metal frame needs a construction review. The term wicker is insufficient.

rows.title: Upholstered seats with wooden frames
rows.officialDescription: Other seats, with wooden frames: Upholstered
rows.condition: An upholstered seat with a wooden frame that is not classified in an earlier special-seat branch.
rows.note: Cover material or visible metal legs alone do not identify the frame. Convertible and height-adjustable swivel seats require the earlier branches to be checked.

rows.title: Other seats with wooden frames
rows.officialDescription: Other seats, with wooden frames: Other
rows.condition: A wooden-frame seat outside the earlier special-seat branches and outside upholstered seats.
rows.note: Explain how any cushioning is fitted and presented. A photograph or the phrase chair with cushion is insufficient to settle upholstery treatment.

rows.title: Upholstered seats with metal frames
rows.officialDescription: Other seats, with metal frames: Upholstered
rows.condition: An upholstered metal-frame seat outside the earlier special-seat branches.
rows.note: Confirm the frame rather than the legs or trim. A height-adjustable swivel office chair may belong in 9401.39 instead.

rows.title: Other seats with metal frames
rows.officialDescription: Other seats, with metal frames: Other
rows.condition: A metal-frame seat outside the earlier special-seat branches and outside upholstered seats.
rows.note: PE-rattan seating with a metal frame needs its construction reviewed; the sales name alone does not establish this result. Separately presented cushions need their own assessment.

rows.title: Other seats
rows.officialDescription: Other seats
products: Plastic seats not covered by an earlier branch
Other seats not covered by an earlier branch
rows.material: Other materials, subject to the preceding seat branches
rows.condition: Use only after excluding the more specific branches of 9401 and furniture of 9402.
rows.note: Mixed-material seating must be assessed using its construction and the interpretation rules. This is not a catch-all for unidentified chairs.

rows.title: Wooden parts of seats
rows.officialDescription: Parts: Of wood
products: Identifiable wooden seat frames presented separately
Identifiable wooden components of seats presented separately
rows.condition: An identifiable part of a seat, presented as a part; apply Chapter 94 exclusions and the rules for unassembled complete articles.
rows.note: Do not treat a complete flat-packed seat as parts automatically. General-use hardware and separately presented bedding articles are excluded.

rows.title: Other parts of seats
rows.officialDescription: Parts: Other
products: Identifiable non-wooden seat frames presented separately
Other identifiable non-wooden seat components eligible for this heading
rows.condition: An identifiable seat part outside the wooden branch, subject to exclusions and the condition as imported.
rows.note: Gas lifts, castors, hinges, screws and mechanisms require independent classification checks; do not route every chair replacement component to this code.

rows.title: Qualifying dental and barber chairs, and parts
rows.officialDescription: Dentists', barbers' or similar chairs and parts thereof
products: Barber chairs with the movements required by heading 9402
rows.material: Any material, within the heading description
rows.condition: For barber and similar chairs, check rotating, reclining and elevating movements. Dental chairs incorporating dental appliances are excluded from Chapter 94.
rows.note: An ordinary salon waiting chair or a chair described only as a beauty chair is not automatically 9402.10.

rows.title: Other medical furniture, and parts
rows.officialDescription: Other medical, surgical, dental or veterinary furniture and parts thereof
rows.material: Any material, within the heading description
rows.condition: The product must meet the medical, surgical, dental or veterinary furniture scope of 9402 and fall outside 9402.10.
rows.note: Ordinary furniture used in a clinic is not necessarily medical furniture. State special fittings and clinical function.

rows.title: Metal office furniture
rows.officialDescription: Metal furniture of a kind used in offices
rows.condition: Furniture of a kind used in offices; exclude seating and other headings.
rows.note: Office chairs are seats under 9401. A product located in an office is not necessarily designed as office furniture.

rows.title: Other metal furniture
rows.officialDescription: Other metal furniture
products: Metal shelving furniture outside the office branch
rows.condition: Metal furniture outside the office branch, excluding seats and products of other headings.
rows.note: Mixed-material tables require a complete construction assessment; metal legs alone do not establish this code. Mattress supports are separately considered under 9404.

rows.title: Wooden office furniture
rows.officialDescription: Wooden furniture of a kind used in offices
rows.condition: Wooden furniture of a kind used in offices; exclude seating and separately imported parts.
rows.note: Confirm the intended furniture function and materials. A domestic side table used occasionally with a laptop does not become office furniture solely by that use.

rows.title: Wooden kitchen furniture
rows.officialDescription: Wooden furniture of a kind used in the kitchen
products: Wooden kitchen islands meeting the furniture definition
rows.condition: Wooden furniture designed for kitchen use, presented as furniture rather than separate parts or unrelated components.
rows.note: A bathroom vanity is not kitchen furniture simply because it has a cabinet. Review countertops, appliances and sinks separately when separately presented.

rows.title: Wooden bedroom furniture
rows.officialDescription: Wooden furniture of a kind used in the bedroom
rows.condition: Wooden furniture of a kind used in the bedroom, excluding mattress supports and bedding.
rows.note: A separate headboard or component needs review as furniture or a part. Do not assign one code to the bed frame, mattress and loose bedding without reviewing how they are presented.

rows.title: Other wooden furniture
rows.officialDescription: Other wooden furniture
products: Wooden bookcases outside the office branch
Wooden vanity cabinets meeting the furniture definition
rows.condition: Wooden furniture outside the office, kitchen and bedroom branches; exclude seats and separately imported parts.
rows.note: For a vanity combined with a basin or a table combining wood and stone, review the whole article and the applicable interpretation rules. The visible top or base alone is insufficient.

rows.title: Plastic furniture
rows.officialDescription: Furniture of plastics
rows.condition: Furniture of plastics within 9403; exclude seats and separately imported parts.
rows.note: Plastic chairs belong in the seat heading. Resin wicker over a metal frame requires a material and construction assessment.

rows.title: Bamboo furniture
rows.officialDescription: Furniture of other materials, including cane, osier, bamboo or similar materials: Of bamboo
rows.condition: Furniture of bamboo within 9403; exclude seats and separately imported parts.
rows.note: Bamboo chairs have a seat branch. State whether the product is bamboo, wood with bamboo decoration, or a composite.

rows.title: Rattan furniture
rows.officialDescription: Furniture of other materials, including cane, osier, bamboo or similar materials: Of rattan
rows.condition: Furniture of rattan within 9403; exclude seats and separately imported parts.
rows.note: PE rattan and resin wicker are not natural rattan. Check the actual materials and construction.

rows.title: Furniture of other materials
rows.officialDescription: Furniture of other materials, including cane, osier, bamboo or similar materials: Other
products: Furniture of materials not covered by an earlier 9403 material branch
Stone or glass furniture where the classification assessment supports this branch
rows.material: Other materials, after assessment of the earlier branches
rows.condition: Furniture within 9403 outside its preceding material branches; apply the interpretation rules to composites.
rows.note: A stone top does not automatically make a complete table 9403.89. Stone or glass sheets/slabs presented alone are excluded from the furniture-parts provisions.

rows.title: Wooden parts of other furniture
rows.officialDescription: Parts: Of wood
products: Identifiable wooden parts of 9403 furniture presented separately
Wooden furniture components eligible under the chapter notes
rows.condition: A separately presented, identifiable wooden furniture part within 9403, subject to exclusions.
rows.note: A complete unassembled cabinet is not automatically classified as parts. Review whether doors, panels or headboards are identifiable parts or complete articles.

rows.title: Other parts of other furniture
rows.officialDescription: Parts: Other
products: Identifiable non-wooden parts of 9403 furniture presented separately
Non-wooden furniture components eligible under the chapter notes
rows.condition: A separately presented, identifiable furniture part within 9403, outside the wooden branch and subject to exclusions.
rows.note: Do not classify general-use hardware, drawer slides, hinges or castors here automatically. Separately presented glass or stone sheets/slabs are excluded by Chapter 94 Note 3(A).

rows.title: Mattress supports
rows.officialDescription: Mattress supports
products: Box springs meeting the heading description
rows.condition: A mattress support within heading 9404; distinguish it from an ordinary bed frame or a furniture part.
rows.note: The names bed base and platform bed are not conclusive. Obtain construction details before selecting between 9403 and 9404.

rows.title: Cellular rubber or plastic mattresses
rows.officialDescription: Mattresses: Of cellular rubber or plastics, whether or not covered
rows.condition: A mattress of cellular rubber or plastics, whether covered or uncovered.
rows.note: Air mattresses and water mattresses are excluded from Chapter 94. A topper or hybrid mattress requires construction review; its marketing name is not enough.

rows.title: Mattresses of other materials
rows.officialDescription: Mattresses: Of other materials
products: Mattresses of other materials outside the cellular-rubber/plastics branch
rows.material: Other than cellular rubber or plastics, subject to composite-product assessment
rows.condition: A mattress within 9404 outside 9404.21; assess multi-material construction.
rows.note: A foam-topped spring mattress needs its construction reviewed. Do not decide from the word hybrid alone. Air and water mattresses are excluded.

rows.title: Sleeping bags
rows.officialDescription: Sleeping bags
rows.condition: A sleeping bag within the heading scope.
rows.note: An infant garment described as a sleep sack is not necessarily a sleeping bag under this heading; establish the article and construction.

rows.title: Quilts, bedspreads and duvets
rows.officialDescription: Quilts, bedspreads, eiderdowns and duvets (comforters)
products: Stuffed or internally fitted duvets and comforters
rows.material: Must meet the stuffing, internal filling or other construction terms of heading 9404
rows.condition: The article must meet the heading description; assess filled or internally fitted construction.
rows.note: Duvet covers, sheets and unfilled textile bedspreads are not automatically included. A product name alone does not establish 9404 coverage.

rows.title: Other bedding and similar furnishings
rows.officialDescription: Other articles of bedding and similar furnishing within heading 9404
rows.material: Sprung, stuffed, internally fitted or cellular construction within heading 9404
rows.condition: An article within heading 9404 outside its more specific branches.
rows.note: An empty cushion cover, an air cushion and a complete framed seat need separate consideration. Separately presented 9404 articles are not classified as furniture parts under 9401–9403.
